Data Analyst

Globex Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
10 hours ago 181 applicants

About Globex

Globex is an award-winning tech scale-up that sells tickets to museums, zoos and attractions in 40 countries. Our team of 300 works from Amsterdam in English.

The role

As our Data Analyst you turn booking and marketing data into decisions. You build dashboards, answer questions from product and marketing teams, and own the weekly numbers.

What you bring
  • 2+ years of experience as a data analyst
  • Strong SQL and one dashboard tool, such as Looker or Tableau
  • Clear writing in English for people who do not read SQL
What we offer
  • A hybrid week, three days in the office
  • Visa sponsorship for candidates from outside the EU
  • 28 holidays and a learning budget
